notes.title: Martha's Dolls Haunts Steam on January 10th!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Mark your calendars[/b] and prepare to scream, because [b]Martha's Dolls[/b] is about to unleash its chilling grip on Steam on January 10th, 2024.
[/h1]

[previewyoutube=S-eVn4cKxhI;full][/previewyoutube]


[h3]Step into a world where porcelain smiles hide insidious secrets, and every creak of floorboard whispers a chilling tale. Martha's Dolls is not just another horror game; it's a descent into a waking nightmare where each doll you encounter harbors a unique, unsettling personality.

Martha's Dolls isn't just about jump scares and gore; it's a slow-burning psychological horror that will crawl under your skin and stay there long after you finish playing. Explore a hauntingly beautiful mansion filled with cryptic puzzles and unsettling secrets. Piece together the tragic story of Martha and her dolls, each fragment revealing a deeper layer of the mansion's macabre history.[/h3]

[h3]But be warned, the closer you get to the truth, the closer the dolls get to you. Can you unravel the mystery before you become another porcelain plaything in Martha's collection?

On January 10th, face your fears and dare to enter the world of Martha's Dolls. Prepare for an unforgettable horror experience that will leave you questioning the line between reality and nightmare.[/h3]

[h1]Add Martha's Dolls to your wishlist on Steam now and get ready to scream![/h1]
